curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach the pre-drive checks, safe backing and where blind spots sit.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule with contrasts on mirrors versus head turns.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions on the check order, backing steps and blind spots.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover perception, reaction and braking distances, then the following gap and when to widen it.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each distance figure and gap rule.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions on stopping distances and following gaps.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach truck spacing, intersection order, who yields at driveways and open crossings, and roundabout rules.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each yield rule with contrasts on arrival order.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Scenario questions on who goes first.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover who is barred from limited roads, entering and exiting, ramp backing and the Move Over law.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each highway rule and Move Over speed.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions on entering, exiting and Move Over speeds.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach parallel parking, hill parking, no-parking places and their distances.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each parking distance and wheel position.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions on no-parking distances and wheel direction on hills.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover how to pass, where passing is banned, being passed, and the limits of right of way.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for passing steps and bans.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions on when passing is allowed.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach speed limits, lane use, HOV lanes, wrong-way reflectors, turn signals and three-point turns.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each limit, lane rule and turn rule.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions on standard limits, lane choice and turning.

learning_path_rule.rule: module order sec07-m01..sec07-m07; component facts before the synthesis (R) nodes that contrast them; no dynamic nodes exist

node_types.definition: one accepted handbook fact as an atomic node
one accepted C2 contrast fact joining the component facts it names

edge_types.definition: component fact must be learned before the contrast or dependent fact

sequencing.rule: module order, then component facts before synthesis nodes
